CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54188  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission on Youth and
  Families meeting of Wednesday, May 15, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54199  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on park permitting from the
  Department of Parks and Recreation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54189  Recommendation to receive and file the We Create Community staff reports from
  May and June 2024 and Director’s Highlights for July 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54190  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the Office of Youth
  Development.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54200  Recommendation to receive and file the Commission on Youth and Families 2023
  Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54201  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current standing committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission on Youth and Families on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Brittany Howe, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Brittany Howe (562) 570-4893.
